evidence.note: Blue is used only for focus/navigation: eyebrow '02 · CONCEPTS' and active nav tab in a darker blue ink, progress bar in the lighter accent; body text and title are neutral.
Base diagram is neutral grey arrows on white cards; no role colour appears before a state is introduced.
Only the highlighted (passing) path and its check badge turn blue; other arrows stay grey.
'Aligned reinforcement:' label in darker blue ink matches the blue aligned reward arrow back to the model.
Red is introduced only for the cheat path and its reward arrow, and for the 'Misaligned reinforcement:' label; both check badges stay blue, marking the shared 'scorer passed' state.
Insight card is neutral (grey label, black serif); no role colour used for emphasis.

rationale: Blue consistently marks focus and the aligned/passing path (with a darker ink for blue text), and red appears only for the misaligned/loss path and its label. Check badges share one colour because both represent the same 'passed the scorer' state, which fits the slide's point. No colour is used decoratively or for a role other than its own.
